source: Which model nodes a car's weight-reduction choices (setup_options.json group "Weight reduction", rg/part_mass.h trim slots) take off the visible car (owner on PR #22, 2026-10-16). Per model (the .glb file's stem) a list of rules {slot, part, hide}: when the setup fits `part` in the part_choice option's `slot`, the model nodes in `hide` are hidden, in the drive (including the cockpit) and in the garage. `after_regeneration` rules name nodes that tools/cargen now produces but the committed .glb files do not have yet (regenerate with `python3 tools/cargen/build.py`, which needs the owner's LFS checkout); a node the loaded model lacks is ignored. `not_separate` says per slot why a model shows no change: the element is part of the body mesh, or the choice is a lighter part of the same shape. Core: rg/strip_visual.h; test tests/unit/test_strip_visual.cpp.

rules.note: the touchscreen and the steering wheel's volume/source buttons; the hands-free button stays; the screen's foot on the dash stays (body mesh)
nodes added by tools/cargen cars/pico.py (children of the doors)

not_separate.dashboard: the element is part of the single body mesh (shared materials with the rest of the cabin), no node of its own (dash_hard, dash_paint, gauges and the climate knobs are one body surface set)
not_separate.sound_deadening: the element is part of the single body mesh (shared materials with the rest of the cabin), no node of its own (no insulation is modelled)
not_separate.carpets: the element is part of the single body mesh (shared materials with the rest of the cabin), no node of its own (carpet surfaces share the cabin shell)
not_separate.spare_wheel: the element is part of the single body mesh (shared materials with the rest of the cabin), no node of its own (no spare wheel or jack is modelled)
not_separate.door_trim: until the model is regenerated the door cards are surfaces of the door nodes
not_separate.seat_passenger: until the model is regenerated the seats are surfaces of the body
not_separate.rear_seats: until the model is regenerated the rear bench is part of the body
not_separate.fasteners: a swap for a lighter part of the same shape: no visual change by design (bolt heads are not modelled)
not_separate.hood: a swap for a lighter part of the same shape: no visual change by design (the carbon weave is not modelled; a tint of the hood's paint surface is an open question)
not_separate.seat_driver: a swap for a lighter part of the same shape: no visual change by design (a bucket seat is not modelled separately)
